component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 text-white transition-colors. Secondary use bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-900.
component_guidelines.cards: Flat solid background (bg-white), rounded-2xl, border border-stone-200, generous padding (p-6 to p-8). Hover states include -translate-y-1 and shadow-lg.
component_guidelines.inputs: Customized Shadcn inputs: rounded-xl, bg-stone-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-200 border-stone-200.
component_guidelines.checkboxes: Large tap targets (h-6 w-6), rounded-md. Checked state bg-orange-600.
component_guidelines.navigation: Sidebar on desktop (w-64, bg-stone-100 border-r border-stone-200). Top nav handles mobile menu and Sign Out. Mobile nav uses glassmorphism if sticky.

grids_layouts.app_layout: flex h-screen overflow-hidden bg-stone-50. Sidebar fixed left (hidden on mobile). Main content flex-1 overflow-y-auto.
grids_layouts.page_container: max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12
grids_layouts.habit_detail: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8. Main content (col-span-2) for 7-day checkboxes and comments. Sidebar (col-span-1) for stats (Days done, Streak).

motion.list_stagger: Framer-motion staggered entrance. Parent: staggerChildren 0.1s. Child: y: 20, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-stone-500 meets APCA standards against stone-50. Use text-stone-600 if needed.
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons must have aria-label.
accessibility.data_testid: Mandatory on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='add-habit-btn', data-testid='habit-checkbox-2026-07-01', data-testid='post-comment-btn').

image_urls.description: Calm, minimal desk with sunlight. Use on the right half of a split-screen desktop Auth layout to evoke calm productivity and morning habits.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Apply 'Generous Spacing' (p-6, p-8) everywhere to ensure the UI feels premium and uncluttered.
Implement the layout with a persistent Sidebar on desktop, and a top nav layout.
Never use generic 'Inter' or 'Roboto' for headings. Use Outfit for headings and Manrope for body text.
Customise Shadcn components to match the 'Organic & Earthy' theme (rounded-2xl, warm stone colors, terracotta CTA).
All interactive elements must include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.
For the 7-day checkboxes, render them prominently with Date labels (YYYY-MM-DD), ensuring large clickable areas.
Keep it simple and focused: do not add features outside the problem statement.
Use Framer Motion to stagger the entrance of Habit cards and comments.
Use javascript (.js / .jsx), DO NOT output typescript (.ts / .tsx).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic: no generic centered layouts, uniform styling, or default SaaS blues.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Ensure crisp edges via semi-transparent borders and nested radii.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform).
DO NOT center align the app container in CSS (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully with backdrop-blur-xl and a subtle border; NEVER use a fully transparent header.
